SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)")
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT schools.School,
       schools.NCESSchool,
       frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.dname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS s 
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds 
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' 
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' 
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' 
  AND "Low Grade" = '9' 
  AND "High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
  AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T3.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T3.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.Phone
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
    SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm AS T1
    INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)"
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Website
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s."AdmEmail1"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Admin1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Admin2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Admin3
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND st.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' 
  AND T1.cname = 'Fresno'

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SchoolName
FROM (
    SELECT sc.School AS SchoolName,
           sc.Virtual AS Virtual,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND rnk <= 5;

SELECT schools.EILName
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
    FROM satscores
);

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = 31
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s.MailStreet, t.sname
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 
  AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailState = 'CA' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT sch.Phone, sch.Ext
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sch ON st.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City = 'Hickman' AND Charter = 1 AND DOC = 52

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = '0'
  AND T1.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] * 100.0 / T1.[Enrollment (K-12)] < 0.18;

SELECT School,
       City,
       AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = '1'
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM schools
WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures
FROM schools
WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District'
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) = '1989'
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31;

SELECT COUNT(StatusType)
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND (SOCType = 'District Community Day School' OR DOCType = 'District Community Day School');
SELECT District FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 0 AND City = 'Fresno'

SELECT T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.City = 'Fremont'
  AND T1.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND T2.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND T1.EdOpsName LIKE '%Youth Authority School%';

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
WHERE EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND NCESDist = '0613360';

SELECT schools.EILName AS `Educational Level Name`, schools.School AS `School Name`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`County Code` = '37';

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND schools.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  AND County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.Latitude, T2.`School Type`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.City, T2.`Low Grade`, T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY T1.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT Fname, District
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
)
WHERE Fname IS NOT NULL
  AND Fname IN (
      SELECT Fname
      FROM (
          SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
      )
      GROUP BY Fname
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 2
  );

SELECT f."District Code",
       f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmLName1 AS "Administrator Last Name",
       District,
       County,
       School
FROM schools
WHERE CharterNum = '40';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmEmail2, T2.AdmEmail3
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.DOC = 54
  AND T2.SOC = 62
  AND T2.OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM users 
WHERE Views > 10 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CreationDate) AS INTEGER) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie');

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts p 
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.Age > 65 AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT u.Location
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.Count = (SELECT MAX(Count) FROM tags);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(badges.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(users.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM users
LEFT JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Views > 200;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN p.Id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 58 AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19'

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Revival';

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN comments ON posts.Id = comments.PostId
WHERE comments.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM comments)

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'not well-finished'
           ELSE 'well-finished'
       END AS status
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Id = (
    SELECT c.PostId
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.UserId = 23853
      AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
);

SELECT u.Reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Id = 65041;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.Id = 6347;

SELECT COUNT(v.Id) AS NumberOfVotes
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'DatEpicCoderGuyWhoPrograms';
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = '24') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = '24') AS posts_to_votes_ratio;
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'SilentGhost';

SELECT c.Text

WITH Consumption2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM Consumption2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM Consumption2013 AS t
    JOIN MinConsumption AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption / NumCustomers AS AvgConsumption
    FROM LowestConsumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS percentage_increase
    FROM cons
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE Match.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' 
AND League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT T2.sprint_speed, T2.agility, T2.acceleration
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';
SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' 
  AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT MAX(m.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_team_score
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';
SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) 
FROM account AS T1 
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id 
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague' AND T3.status IN ('A', 'C');
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) 
FROM district d 
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND d.A11 > 6000 
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T1.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T2.A11 AS gap
FROM disp AS T1
INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T3.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T3.gender = 'F'
  AND T3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND T2.A11 = (SELECT MIN(T5.A11)
                FROM client AS T4
                INNER JOIN district AS T5 ON T4.district_id = T5.district_id
                WHERE T4.gender = 'F'
                  AND T4.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))

SELECT A.account_id
FROM account A
JOIN disp D ON A.account_id = D.account_id
JOIN client C ON D.client_id = C.client_id
JOIN district T ON C.district_id = T.district_id
WHERE C.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT T1.client_id FROM client AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T2.type = 'DISPONENT' AND T3.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND l.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.status = 'A'
        AND l2.date LIKE '1997%'
        AND a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  );
SELECT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.duration > 12 AND T1.date LIKE '1993%' ORDER BY T2.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND T2.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT account_id 
FROM account 
WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM account WHERE SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '1995')

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id 
FROM account AS T1 
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) < '1997' 
  AND T2.amount > 3000;

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.issued = '1994-03-03';
SELECT T1.date FROM account AS T1 JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.amount = 840 AND T2.date = '1998-10-14';
SELECT T1.district_id FROM account AS T1 JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date = '1994-08-25' AND T2.status = 'A'
